rows.grounds: fused form kuryāt + tasya + ājñayā; optative of kṛ with instrumental phrase

items.question: Must every action be performed always under the guru's command after worshipping him?
items.inference: The practitioner's every act is guru-authorized.
uncertainties: The fused token kuryāttasyā'jñayā combines verb and instrumental phrase; exact sandhi boundary is as printed.
items.plain_english: Having worshipped, one should always perform all action by his command.
